id: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)

ops.ren: Venice cod, prosciutto and sardine toasts

ops.to: Baguette toasts with smoked cod, prosciutto and fig, or sardines and raisins.

ops.ren: Circus train peanut caramel popcorn balls

ops.to: Nuts and kernels in corn syrup toffee, fist-sized, for Marcus Brody's visit.
Homemade soft pretzels with a warm camembert and paprika butter dip.

ops.ren: Hatay lamb kebabs with garlic yogurt

ops.to: Spiced ground lamb with sumac and parsley on skewers, grilled hot, with flatbread.
Crisp pork schnitzel with warm potato salad, cut at the desk among the notes.
Almond and pistachio cake soaked in lemon rosewater syrup, a slice beside the diary.
Medjool dates stuffed with almonds, wrapped in bacon and drizzled with honey. Good ones.
Crisp fritters of raw chickpeas and herbs with lemon tahini sauce, by the stove.
Gruyère and cayenne choux baked hollow, tomato dip, gold as the idol.
Semolina, coconut and yoghurt cake with an almond on each square, soaked in syrup.

id: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001)

ops.to: Turkey breast with chipolatas in bacon and honey parsnips, there the moment the feast appears.

value.note: Sausages in bacon with cranberry sauce, piled on the house tables.

id: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)

ops.to: Crisp choux filled with vanilla Chantilly, pale purple icing and a sugared flower on top.
Hard buttery toffee of brown sugar, treacle and golden syrup, wrapped for Ginny's trunk.
Fresh green apple juice jelly set in small glasses, wobbly as Errol's landings.

id: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)

ops.to: Crunchy honeycomb broken into slabs and half dipped in dark chocolate, good after a dementor.
Condensed milk and coconut in white and pink layers, cut chunky and kept in a jar on the bar.
Crisp Earl Grey and lemon shortbread with a pot of tea. No Grim in the cup.

id: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)

ops.to: Sticky pan fried sausages and golden onions in soft rolls, passed round late in the night.

id: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (2007)

ops.ren: Hog's Head pork and sage sausage rolls

ops.to: Mince, onion and herbs in puff pastry, baked golden, with English mustard on the side.

ops.ren: Great Hall thyme roast chicken and gravy

ops.to: Chicken roasted with thyme, potatoes and gravy, for the Order round the long table.
Vanilla cupcakes with bright pink buttercream, the colour of Tonks's hair this week.

id: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009)

ops.to: Peppery skirt, potato, swede and onion in crimped shortcrust, cut small for the party.
Dark chocolate and cream truffles rolled in cocoa. Check who sent them.
Syrup toffee foamed with bicarb, set crunchy and half dipped in dark chocolate.

id: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010)

ops.value: Serve the snacks when the trio pitch the tent in the forest.

ops.to: Blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, plus gruyère choux, from the beaded bag.
Ham, vintage cheddar and English mustard toasted in buttered bread over the camp stove.
Mayo and lemon crab on toasted sourdough fingers, the tins packed by Hermione.

ops.ren: Frozen pond foil baked trout with potatoes

ops.to: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil in the embers.

ops.ren: Godric's Hollow steak and onion pie

ops.to: Steak and onion under puff pastry, eaten in the tent on a snowy Christmas Eve.
Butter sponge layers with lemon zest and lemon curd, a slice wrapped for later.

id: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011)

ops.to: Crisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilli, for the students holding out.

ops.ren: Hogsmeade sausage rolls with brown sauce

ops.to: Pork and sage sausage rolls with brown sauce, sent up the tunnel by Aberforth.

ops.ren: Platform nine and three-quarters treacle tart

ops.to: Golden syrup and lemon treacle tart, served warm in thick slices.

value.note: Fish finger sandwiches with tartare sauce, cut in halves for the room.

id: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016)

value.note: Gin, lemon, sugar and soda, shaken. It's Prohibition, so ask quietly.

id: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018)

ops.ren: Hogwarts staff room chicken leek pie

ops.to: Browned chicken thigh in creamy thyme and Dijon sauce under puff, sold by the slice.

id: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022)

ops.to: Soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water and topped with rock salt, for the German delegation.

ops.ren: Hog's Head sausage rolls and brown sauce

ops.to: Pork, onion and sage rolled in puff and baked golden, with tangy brown sauce.
Crumbed pork loin fried in butter, warm potato salad, served once the votes are in.
Dough parcels of mashed potato and cheddar, boiled then pan-fried with onions.
Butter sponge layers with buttercream and raspberry jam, iced and cut for the winner.
Crisp fried croquettes of shredded beef in a thick creamy filling.

ops.ren: Rome pork saltimbocca with sage butter

ops.to: Caramel wafers and vanilla ice cream under hot espresso, on the terrace.

ops.ren: Dyess farm biscuits and sausage gravy

ops.to: Buttermilk biscuits under peppery sausage gravy, ladled onto the tray.
Roast turkey with cornbread stuffing, gravy and cranberry sauce, on a steel tray.

id: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008)

ops.to: Thick twice-fried fries with sea salt and ketchup, eaten between crates.
Flaky pastry round cumin ground beef, olive and egg, baked golden, green salsa.
Charred garlic cumin drumsticks with cilantro jalapeño sauce and fries.
